topology_reasoning.device_hypothesis: A four-port symmetric clover/cross made from a central multimode body with four identical lobes and four narrow access stems on the cardinal axes.
topology_reasoning.working_principle: The image is mirror-symmetric in x and y, with identical narrow stems feeding a broader central interaction region. Function is likely defined by lobe size, lobe placement, and stem width/length rather than by fine internal substructure, because the bitmap contains one connected filled region with no etched holes or gaps.
topology_reasoning.coding_plan: Model the shape as the boolean union of four ellipses and four rectangles. Keep all tunables as top-level assignments. Use delta_length to add equal extra straight length to the north and south stems so the knob changes real geometry by width*delta while preserving the baseline symmetric target at delta_length = 0.

iterations.change_made: Initial measured model using four ellipses plus four rectangles. Removed the @gf.cell wrapper so the written GDS exposes the real device cell at top level for evaluator area measurement without changing geometry.
